decisions.statement: Every value the script has is base64 encoded before the shell reads the value.
An attachment is written to a temporary folder the script removes on exit.
Each send is its own call to osascript rather than a statement sharing one call.
A send that landed is echoed before the next send runs.
A send that raised stops the script, so nothing after it is echoed.
The words a marker is read as are written here rather than where it is read.

definition: the script handing a message to Messages on the machine that sends it
